caption: The drawing depicts a round wooden table with a thick, brown tabletop that exhibits visible grain and knots in the wood. The base of the table consists of two vertical, scalloped-edged side supports and a central panel across the middle, all rendered in light reddish-brown and pink hues, suggesting a stained or painted wood. Above the table, there is a horizontal, narrow piece labeled "Side support for Table-top" in handwritten text, drawn in a similar pink color with scalloped detailing along the lower edge. The drawing has a soft, pale background, and the entire composition uses lightly blended shades of brown, pink, and beige, giving distinction to the wood parts and edges.
title: Table
